title: Cream Knit with Blue Patterns & Sunglasses
prompt: An original young woman with long, wavy copper hair wears blue-tinted cat-eye sunglasses and a long, dangling blue bead earring. She wears a cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top with a blue and black patterned bib panel, a matching patterned high collar scarf, and patterned cuffs. Light wash denim jeans with rhinestone details and her hands rest in her pockets. Her expression is calm and direct. A dark, textured backdrop with soft light. Palette of cream, cornflower blue, black, and pale denim. Bold and retro, in the style of a Y2K knitwear catalog.
workingNotes:
- The blue pattern and cat-eye sunglasses are the signature accents.
- Keep the dark backdrop to make the cream knit stand out.
tryThis: Try this: Keep the dark backdrop to emphasize the cream knit.
